preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text, each representing a line from stdin.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input is non-empty and each line is non-empty after stripping whitespace.

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == T and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: First line is a valid integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N + 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]) and all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains N+1 space-separated integers (N followed by N colors), and the third line (if exists) is empty or ignored.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a valid integer (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(A) <= 10**9 for A in [int(num) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2] for num in line.split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each color value A_i is a valid integer (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(min_operations) for min_operations in [compute_min_operations(A) for A in test_cases]]
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer representing the minimum number of mixing operations required to make all color values pairwise distinct. The output is space-separated for all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(min_operations >= 0 for min_operations in [compute_min_operations(A) for A in test_cases])
postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations is always non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(A)) == len(A) or compute_min_operations(A) == 0 for A in test_cases)
postconditions.description: If all color values are already pairwise distinct, the minimum number of operations is zero.

postconditions.expression: all(compute_min_operations(A) == len(A) - len(set(A)) for A in test_cases if len(set(A)) < len(A))
postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations is equal to the number of duplicates (len(A) - len(set(A))) when duplicates exist, as each duplicate can be resolved with one operation.
